title: agent_identity (SPEC 17.1): who the agent is, whom it belongs to, how it proves itself at run time
description: Signed by the issuer that onboarded the agent and saw its principal (the same hash as in the mandate). Carried in the A2A agent card under capabilities.extensions[].params.identity. Its hash, sha256hex(canonical(object)) with sig, is what a mandate, a decision and an evidence object name. Ed25519 over canonical JSON without sig, as every object of this specification.

principal.description: sha256hex of the issuer's own reference to the principal. A hash, never a name: two identities of one principal are recognisable, nobody learns who it is. An agent without a principal has no identity (law 3).

runtime.description: The strong run-time identity. SPIFFE: the gateway terminates mTLS and compares the peer's SPIFFE ID. Key: the agent signs { transfer, agent, aud } per request with this Ed25519 key.

card.description: The A2A agent card this identity is for: endpoint and skills are fixed by its hash (sha256hex(canonical(card))). A changed card is a new identity.

pass.description: The agent's Word Pass URL (SPEC 9), or null.

expires_at.description: Required. An identity without expiry is rejected (IDENTITY_EXPIRED).
